rows.text: Heliod puts a +1/+1 counter on a creature every time you gain life, and for {1}{W} gives another creature lifelink. Give Walking Ballista lifelink and every ping gains a life, which puts the counter right back on Ballista: unlimited damage from two cards, one of which is your commander. The rest of the deck finds Ballista or Triskelion and stops the table from doing anything about it.

rows.name: Heliod, Sun-Crowned
rows.text: three mana, indestructible. Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature or enchantment you control. {1}{W}: another target creature gains lifelink until end of turn.
Heliod is only a creature with five devotion to white, and the combo does not need him to be one. He just needs to be on the battlefield.
He is indestructible, so exile, bounce and tuck effects are what stop him. Hold Mother of Runes, Giver of Runes or a counterspell-style stax piece for those.

rows.name: Heliod, Sun-Crowned + Walking Ballista
rows.text: cast Ballista with X of at least 1, pay {1}{W} to give it lifelink, then remove a counter to ping. You gain 1, Heliod puts a counter back on Ballista, repeat. Unlimited damage and life. Seven mana across two turns: Heliod (3) one turn, then Ballista with X = 1 (2) and the activation (2).

rows.name: Heliod, Sun-Crowned + Triskelion
rows.text: the same loop with Triskelion, which enters with three counters already.

rows.name: Walking Ballista + Agatha's Soul Cauldron
rows.text: if Ballista is in your graveyard, exile it with the Cauldron. Every creature you control with a +1/+1 counter gains its abilities, so give one of them lifelink with Heliod and loop the same way.
Two cards, with the commander as one of them: allowed in Bracket 3, used from turn 6 on.

guide.title: Tutor lines — what to fetch, and when

rows.text: Every tutor in the deck can find Ballista. Pick the one that leaves mana for the activation the same turn.

rows.name: Ranger-Captain of Eos -> Walking Ballista
rows.text: Ballista has mana value 0 in your library, so it counts as a one-drop. Three mana for the Captain, and you can sacrifice it to stop opponents casting noncreature spells on the combo turn.

rows.name: Recruiter of the Guard -> Walking Ballista
rows.text: any creature with toughness 2 or less: Ballista (0) or Triskelion (1).

rows.name: Ranger of Eos -> Walking Ballista
rows.text: two creatures of mana value 1 or less: Ballista plus Mother of Runes or Esper Sentinel.

rows.name: Enlightened Tutor -> Walking Ballista
rows.text: it's an artifact, so Enlightened Tutor puts it on top. Cast it at an opponent's end step and draw it next turn.

rows.name: Scrapyard Recombiner -> Triskelion
rows.text: sacrifice an artifact to tutor any Construct: Ballista, Triskelion, or the Recombiner itself.

rows.name: Inventors' Fair -> Walking Ballista
rows.text: with three artifacts out, a land that tutors any artifact.

rows.name: Buried Ruin -> Walking Ballista
rows.text: returns an artifact from your graveyard to hand.

guide.title: The stax shell — use it, but know it cuts both ways

rows.text: These slow the table down while you assemble two cards. Most are symmetric, so play them when they hurt the opponents more than you.

rows.name: Rule of Law
rows.text: one spell per turn for everyone. Your combo is one spell (Ballista) and an activation, so it still works.

rows.name: Eidolon of Rhetoric
rows.text: the same, on a creature.

rows.name: Archon of Emeria
rows.text: the same, and their nonbasic lands enter tapped.

rows.name: Phyrexian Censor
rows.text: one non-Phyrexian spell each per turn, and non-Phyrexian creatures enter tapped.

rows.name: Deafening Silence
rows.text: one noncreature spell per turn each.

rows.name: Ethersworn Canonist
rows.text: artifact spells are exempt, so Ballista still resolves after another spell.

rows.name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
rows.text: noncreature spells cost {1} more. Your combo pieces are creatures.

rows.name: Chalice of the Void
rows.text: counters every spell with a chosen mana value. Pick a number your opponents use more than you do; set to 1, it also counters your Swords and Path.

rows.name: Silence

rows.name: Orim's Chant

rows.name: Linvala, Keeper of Silence

rows.name: Blind Obedience
rows.text: their artifacts and creatures enter tapped, and extort drains on every spell.

rows.name: Path to Exile
rows.text: the same.

guide.title: What to keep in an opening hand

rows.text: Keep a land count of three, some acceleration, and either a combo piece or a tutor for it. Turn three Heliod; Ballista can land before then, but go off with {1}{W} up from turn 6.
Land one lock piece early (Rule of Law, Archon of Emeria, Grand Abolisher) to slow the table, but don't play two that also strangle you.
On the combo turn: Grand Abolisher or Silence first, then Ballista, then the activation.
